key_highlights: ASX closed the week lower as bond yields surged, signalling market repricing toward higher-for-longer RBA rates (#47, #1)
CBA reports home loan applications down 15% since budget; banks forecast record house price falls (#64, #62)
Bathla construction collapse flagged as systemic warning for Australia's housing/construction sector (#43, #50)
Iron ore 'shakeout' masked by geopolitical noise; Macarthur clears WA bulk test hurdle (#49, #67)
TMK Energy gas rates surge ahead of Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel scrutiny intensifies (#66, #72)
EV sales overtook petrol cars in Australia for first time amid record diesel prices (#40, #4)
RBA cautioned against premature rate hikes as economy 'limps along' (#74)
ASIC launches whistleblower review at Big Four accounting firms (#51)
Aurum adds high-grade gold ounces; small-cap miners (Kaoko, Vanadium, Piche) lead ASX runners (#38, #30)

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces a structural shakeout amid demand concerns, but WA exploration (Macarthur) and gold (Aurum) provide selective upside. Small-cap miners active.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from iron ore softness; gold names (GOLD.AX, WES.AX) and explorers (KAOK.AX, VAN.AX, PIC.AX) offer relative strength.

sectors.trend: CBA flags 15% drop in home loan applications; banks project record house price declines. Fee-pricing scrutiny on CBA/Westpac. ASIC whistleblower review adds governance risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM compression and credit-cycle headwinds; defensive dividend yield remains attractive but growth outlook weakens.

sectors.trend: TMK Energy gas rates surge on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo gas cartel debate; energy transition costs mounting. Diesel at all-time highs.
sectors.implications: TMK.AX, BGL.AX, WDS.AX benefit from gas pricing; WES.AX, SAI.AX face transition-cost overhang. Diesel spike pressures transport and agribusiness margins.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse signals sector-wide fragility; housing construction to follow falling prices; Melbourne councils admit infrastructure shortfall. Victoria debt ratings under pressure.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) and builders (WBC.AX exposure, listed developers) face demand contraction. Rate-sensitive property equities under pressure.

sectors.trend: EV sales surpassed petrol cars for first time; diesel at record highs accelerating shift. Hidden EV costs (grid, charging) emerging.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX see mixed impact; auto suppliers and charging-infrastructure names gain. Fuel-cost savings boost discretionary spend.

sectors.trend: Ozempic maker (Novo Nordisk) in trouble; tablet alternatives emerging. Nvidia confirms AI boom continues. ASIC review touches Big Four.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (pharma) monitor GLP-1 disruption. Tech exposure via ASX-listed data-centre and AI plays (SOL.AX, PIV.AX).

key_themes: Higher-for-longer rates pressuring rate-sensitive sectors (housing, REITs, homebuilders)
Iron ore structural shakeout vs. gold/exploration resilience
Australian housing cycle turning: falling prices, collapsing construction, record bank forecasts
Energy transition cost overhang vs. gas pricing tailwinds
EV adoption inflection point in Australia
Governance/regulatory risk: ASIC whistleblower review, bank fee scrutiny
Geopolitical overlay: Ukraine drone attack, Argentina-Falklands oil sanctions, yen volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / bond yield surge
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce REIT and homebuilder exposure; hedge with rate caps on floating debt.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction / construction sector fragility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight listed developers and construction-linked equities; monitor CBA loan-application data as leading indicator.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand shock / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify materials exposure toward gold, lithium, and rare earths; monitor Macarthur and WA bulk-test outcomes.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy transition cost overrun / gas pricing volatility
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour integrated energy names with gas hedges; monitor TMK and Beetaloo regulatory developments.
Monitor ASIC whistleblower outcomes; assess CBA.AX, WBC.AX fee-revenue concentration risk.
Maintain gold allocation; monitor AUD/USD and JPY cross for risk-off spillover.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and exploration names amid iron ore shakeout
opportunities.rationale: Gold benefits from rate uncertainty and geopolitical risk; Aurum's high-grade ounces and small-cap runners signal sector rotation.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gas/energy exposure on TMK rate surge
opportunities.rationale: TMK gas rates spiking on Mongolian drilling; Beetaloo cartel debate may unlock pricing reform.
EV sales surpassed petrol for first time; structural demand shift supports charging-network and battery-material equities.

defensive_moves.rationale: Record house price fall forecasts, 15% loan-application drop, and Bathla collapse signal sector-wide contraction.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim iron ore-heavy mining weight; diversify to gold/lithium
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore shakeout masked by geopolitics; structural demand risk from China and global slowdown.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration fixed income
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond yields soaring; RBA may hike again despite weak growth, pressuring duration-sensitive equities.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as bond yields stay elevated, housing data deteriorates, and RBA signals caution. Iron ore volatility and construction-sector stress (Bathla) will cap upside. Gold and gas names provide relative outperformance. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow, lower range.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots on softening growth and housing data. EV transition, energy infrastructure, and resource diversification (gold, rare earths, lithium) offer structural themes. Housing correction may deepen before stabilising; bank credit cycles will be the key swing factor.

TMK/Beetaloo gas pricing and regulatory developments
EV sales monthly figures and charging-infrastructure policy

Iron ore (62% Fe) spot and futures
CBA.AX, WBC.AX loan-application and NIM prints
GOLD.AX, WES.AX gold production and pricing
ASIC enforcement actions on accounting firms
